aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer defined as stage 3 or higher or death from prostate cancer, but the abstract combines men who already had prostate cancer with those diagnosed during follow-up.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: Of the 2,268 men, 347 had or were diagnosed with PCa during follow-up, 63 with advanced disease (stage 3+ or died of PCa).
study_design: AGES-Reykjavik cohort analysis with registry linkage, combining prevalent and follow-up-diagnosed prostate cancer cases.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: From 2002 to 2006, 2,268 men, aged 67-96 years, reported their dietary habits in the AGES-Reykjavik cohort study.
reason: The abstract analyzes total prostate cancer diagnosis and advanced disease, but explicitly combines men who already had prostate cancer with men diagnosed during follow-up. It therefore does not establish an aggressive incident endpoint in an initially cancer-free population.

estimate_classifications.reason: The supplied full-text evidence identifies this oatmeal estimate as incident prostate cancer. The abstract itself describes a mixed group who had or were diagnosed with prostate cancer, so abstract support alone is insufficient to establish incidence.
